key_points: Qualcomm and Huawei signed a multi-year 5G patent licensing agreement, potentially stabilizing licensing revenue.
Qualcomm targets $40B non-handset revenue by an unspecified future date, signaling diversification beyond smartphones.
New smartphone chip launches and AI-focused product push indicate strength in core mobile and AI markets.
A reported Meta partnership and AI revenue targets drove an after‑hours 15% stock jump, showing investor optimism.
Ongoing legal tension with Arm over chip testing tools introduces near‑term uncertainty and possible cost pressure.
